# vscode language detection

Docker compose files like `**/*docker-compose.sops.yaml` are picked up by the Containers/Docker Compose language support, which prevents the `@signageos/vscode-sops` extension auto-decrypting and auto-encrypting them. To prevent this, add the following to the workspace settings.json

```json
{
  "settings": {
		"files.associations": {
			"docker-compose.sops.yaml": "yaml",
			".decrypted~docker-compose.sops.yaml": "yaml"
		}
  }
}
```
